name: Marine Dietrich
original_name: マリーン・デートリッヒ
source:
Passenger in the first-class coach.
She is on the luxury express train, the Magic Arrow, with her fiancé, Francis, who is younger than her.
Until a few years ago, she was performing in small theaters while studying hard to become an actress, but she realized her lack of talent, gave up on her dream, and started running a small bar.
Although she has given up on her dream, she has not abandoned it. She'd be lying if she said she had no regrets, but she tried to play many different characters, and now that she has a job that allows her to interact with many different people, she feels that her life is worth living.
In fact, she has been married once. She was married to an older musician, Val, whom she met when she was an actress, but he died of illness just two months after their marriage. Five years later, she finally recovered from the sorrow of bereavement and bought a ticket for a prenuptial trip with Francis, the love of her life, who is her new mutual support. However, that night, Val's ghost suddenly appears, stalks Marine, and begins to torment her about her marriage to Francis.
At first, she is surprised and thinks it is a hallucination, but the ghost shows no sign of disappearing. When Val appeared, Marlene was puzzled, angry, and reminiscing about the old days. For some reason, she can only see her late husband. She is the only one who can talk to him. Talking with Val, she feels refreshed and at peace. That's when she realized she was still in love with this man.
